effect.ibarnorigins.soul_fire_effect.des: Yettak-d arurad n lmut akked ummesten i uzgu n lǧerḥ deg wakud. Ma yella yettunefk-it-id sɣur Soul Sorcerer, yettak-d lǧerḥ s ugmuḍ yebnan ɣef tezmert tafellayt n yiswi.
effect.ibarnorigins.casting_soul_firebal: Tazemmar n tkerrust n tmes n tarwiḥt n yimeskaren n tarwiḥt. Yettarra-d tarwiḥt n tmes n tarwiḥt deg ugmuḍ n ugmuḍ.
effect.ibarnorigins.soul_fire_strength_e: Ad isnerni lexsara n umennuɣ s 50% deg uswir 1 akked 100% deg uswir 2.
effect.ibarnorigins.fire_weakness_effect: Ad isnerni lexsara seg yiɣbula n tmes s 100%.
entity.ibarnorigins.owned_area_effect_cl: Takebbanit n usigna n ugmuḍ n temnaḍt
death.attack.ibarnorigins.soul_burn.play: Tarwiḥt n %1$s terɣa mi yella yettaɛraḍ ad yerwel seg %2$s
death.attack.ibarnorigins.soulBlast.play: %1$s yettwaffuɣ s tezmert n terwiḥt mi yella yettaɛraḍ ad yerwel seg %2$s
origin.ibarnorigins.ghaster.name: Ghaster
origin.ibarnorigins.ghaster.description: D arraw ibeɛden n Ghasts i d-yettwasellken seg Nether yerna uɣalen d imdanen ssebba n tuqqna-nsen ɣezzifen ɣer Overworld.
origin.ibarnorigins.sandman.name: Amdan n yijdi
origin.ibarnorigins.sandman.description: Agdud n yijdi d agdud n yijdi yettidiren deg yijdi.
origin.ibarnorigins.soul_wizard.name: Soul Sorcerer
origin.ibarnorigins.soul_wizard.descript: Taɣremt n yemdanen i izemren ad d-awin tazmert n terwiḥt-nsen.
origin.ibarnorigins.wither_phantom.name: Wether Wraith
origin.ibarnorigins.wither_phantom.descr: Amalgamat n uzgen n wid yeddren d uzgen n wid ur nemmut, i yeqqlen d wid yesɛan tazmert n lmut i lebda s ssebba n umtawi akked yiɣes n lmut.
power.ibarnorigins.ghasterexhaust.name: Tafizikt taẓeyt
power.ibarnorigins.ghasterexhaust.descri: Ɣas akken tuɣaleḍ tettawiḍ iman-ik ugar ɣer Overworld, ur tesɛiḍ ara tazmert s wudem udmawan, tzemreḍ ad d-tekkseḍ aẓru s leɛqel cwiṭ, ad d-tgeḍ azal n 25% n wuguren n melee, daɣen tzemreḍ ad teɛyiḍ s tɣawla.
power.ibarnorigins.ghasterfireball.name: Tummant n Fireball
power.ibarnorigins.ghasterfireball.descr: Ulamma teǧǧan-k ɣer umaḍal afellay, teṭṭfeḍ-d tizemmar-nni meqqren n leǧruḥ n leǧruḥ n lejdud-ik, xersum alamma d kra.
power.ibarnorigins.ghasterinflate.name: Afelleq
power.ibarnorigins.ghasterinflate.descri: Ma tneggzeḍ s tuffra, ad k-id-yeǧǧ ad d-teffuɣeḍ u ad tettiliḍ kra n wakud.
power.ibarnorigins.ki_immunity.name: Azbu Ki
power.ibarnorigins.kiblast.name: Soul Fire Ball
power.ibarnorigins.kiblast.description: Sali-d tiɣmert n tmes tameẓyant i yesserɣayen tarwiḥt, i d-yettnerni deg tezmert mi ara yuli uswir-ik n termit (ad yaweḍ ɣer uswir 100).
power.ibarnorigins.sandman_attributes.de: Ur ttḍurru ara aṭas ticki teqqimeḍ ɣef yiḥedran n yijdi, maca ɣas ḍurru 50% ticki teqqimeḍ ɣef wayen nniḍen ur nelli ara d ijdi. D acu kan, ad d-trebbḥeḍ dima deg uneẓruf.
power.ibarnorigins.sandman_sandbury.name: Akellex n yijdi
power.ibarnorigins.sandman_sandbury.desc: Tzemreḍ ad teɣzeḍ iman-ik deg ṛṛmel. Ma teɣzeḍ, ur tettbaneḍ ara.
power.ibarnorigins.sandman_shovel_damage: Rnu 150% n wuguren i d-tettḍurru tqecwalt.
power.ibarnorigins.soul_speed.name: Arured n tarwiḥt
power.ibarnorigins.soul_speed.descriptio: Tazmert n terwiḥt deg yijdi n terwiḥt d wakal n terwiḥt ad k-teǧǧ ad tessikleḍ s zzerb.
power.ibarnorigins.soulfire_strength.des: Rnu 50% n lexṣara mi ara teqqimeḍ ɣer yiri n yiɣbula n tmes n terwiḥt neɣ mi ara teṭṭfeḍ iferdisen-nsen. Ugar n waya, ma teqqimeḍ srid sdaxel n tmes n terwiḥt, ad ternuḍ aqeṛṛu-ik ɣer 100% n lexṣara-nniḍen akked 50% n lexṣara-nniḍen n terwiḥt n tmes n terwiḥt.
power.ibarnorigins.soulmage_fireweakness: Xas akken tettḥulfuḍ iman-ik tgerrzeḍ ɣer tmes n terwiḥt, times n yal ass i d-yettruḥen seg tmes d tmes n lexla tesɛa kra n usemmiḍ i k-yessewḥayen. Akka daɣen, tettaɣeḍ ugar n 100% n lexsara sɣur tmes, dɣa ad teqqleḍ d aderɣal mi ara k-teḍṛu tmes.
power.ibarnorigins.soulmage_piglinfear.d: Tafat n terwiḥt tamezwarut i ireqqen sdaxel-ik tettak-d tugdi i yal yiwen anagar i yigulufen iǧehden akk.
power.ibarnorigins.soulmage_vegetarian.d: Aksum ur yesɛi ara aṭas n tezmert n terwiḥt am yizegza. Dɣa aksum ur yesɛi ara aṭas n teɣzi, maca izegza ttaken-d tarmit mi ara tt-nečča ɣef leḥsab n wamek i d-rnan.
power.ibarnorigins.witherskull.name: Homing Wither Skull
power.ibarnorigins.witherskull.descripti: Sewḥel tazmert n wid ur nemmut ara, tesnulfuḍ-d iqejjiren yeqquren i yettnadin ɣef yeɛdawen-ik.
power.ibarnorigins.wp_item_prevention.de: Ur tezmireḍ ara ad telseḍ kra n lqecc i yugaren lqecc n wuzzal.
power.ibarnorigins.wpairswim.name: Afeggag
power.ibarnorigins.wpairswim.description: Tafekka-k fessus aṭas, tzemreḍ ad tɛummeḍ deg uzwu.
power.ibarnorigins.wphealth.name: Aḥerfi
power.ibarnorigins.wphealth.description: Ɣef sebba n umṣada-k, tafekka-k teqqel d taḥerfit mliḥ (5 n wulawen) dɣa ur tezmireḍ ara ad d-tefkeḍ aṭas n wuguren meqqren.
power.ibarnorigins.wphit.name: Iɣewwaṛen n usewḥel
power.ibarnorigins.wphit.description: S yal aqeṛṛu i d-tettawḍeḍ, tettawḍeḍ-asen-d aqeṛṛu i iɛdawen-ik.
